units.source_text: 當天夜裡，我躲在被窩裡直打哆嗦，總惦記著這件事，

en.t: That night, I hid under the covers trembling, unable to stop thinking about it,

units.source_text: 然後我悄悄起身來到客廳，開啟父親剛才放記事本的抽屜，

en.t: then I quietly got up and went to the sitting room, and opened the drawer where Father had just put his notebook,

units.source_text: 取出記事本，嘩啦嘩啦地翻到他寫過禮物的那一頁，

en.t: took out the notebook, and flipped through it noisily to the page where he had written about the gifts,

units.source_text: 舔了一下鉛筆，寫上「獅子舞」後，又返回被窩睡覺了。

en.t: licked the pencil, wrote in “lion dance,” then went back under the covers and slept.

units.source_text: 其實我一點也不想要什麼「獅子舞」面具，想要的反倒還是書。

en.t: In truth, I did not want a “lion dance” mask at all; what I wanted instead was still a book.

units.source_text: 可是，我覺察到了父親想送我「獅子舞」面具，

en.t: But I realized that Father wanted to give me a “lion dance” mask,

units.source_text: 為了迎合父親的心意，討他開心，我才膽敢深夜冒險潛入客廳。

en.t: so, to fall in with his wishes and make him happy, I dared to risk sneaking into the sitting room late at night.

units.source_text: 果然，我的這招非常手段，如願獲得了巨大成功，得到了回報。

en.t: Sure enough, this extraordinary measure of mine achieved a great success just as I had hoped, and I was rewarded for it.
